name: silence-with-candidates
description: Silence that had to be EARNED: every quiet turn extracts entity candidates, one of them resolves to a real page, and the confidence gate declines it anyway.

pages.title: Alice Ng
pages.body: Alice Ng runs the design studio we contract.

pages.title: Bluefin Labs
pages.body: Bluefin Labs builds the sensor hardware.

turns.text: Are we still working with Alice this week?
turns.note: "Alice" is neither a declared alias nor the title, so it can only reach people/alice on the slug-suffix arm: 0.60 + 0.05 = 0.65, under the 0.70 gate. Candidates exist, a pointer resolves, and the brain declines — this turn reaches the injection decision and fails a regression that lowers the gate.

turns.text: Priya Raman asked about the sensor roadmap.
turns.note: A confident candidate for a person the brain has never heard of. Nothing resolves; Alice is still in the window and still gated.

turns.text: Bluefin Labs shipped the new sensor.
turns.note: Proves the fixture is not degenerately silent: the same conversation speaks when a title is named outright.
